description: Implement Glosario, Timeline, and FAQ pages with API routes, services, and sidebar nav items
steps: Create glossary extractor service at src/lib/services/glossary-extractor.ts
Create /glosario page with searchable term listing
Create /timeline page with vertical timeline visualization
Create /faq page with accordion FAQ display
Add all three nav items to sidebar.tsx
acceptance_criteria: Glossary extractor scans documents rawText for acronyms (2-6 ALL CAPS chars) and terms with definitions
GET /api/glosario returns terms with definitions and source document info
Glosario page displays searchable term list with definition and source
GET /api/timeline returns chronological events based on user creation + plazo_dias
Timeline page displays vertical timeline with 30/60/90 day markers and rhythms
GET /api/faq returns pre-built FAQ without AI from user data
FAQ page displays questions in accordion format
All three pages appear in sidebar navigation
findings: All 3 features implemented and build passes. 11 new files created. Pages: /glosario, /timeline, /faq. API routes: /api/glosario, /api/timeline, /api/faq. Service: glossary-extractor.ts. Sidebar updated with nav items in MI GESTION (timeline) and DOCUMENTOS (glosario, faq) groups.
